title: Add onboarding conciliator and distilled release-brief generator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: onboarding remains noisy because provider manifests vary widely (license formats, tokenizer hints, safety classification, and perf telemetry). This change introduces an onboarding conciliator service + CLI that consumes disparate manifests and emits a normalized v2 profile plus a distilled release brief used to seed automated changelogs. The conciliator applies rule-driven reconciliation, ranks short brief fragments by evidence weight, and emits an audit block capturing every decision with source fingerprints and a signature hash. The flow is interactive by default (CLI prompts) and supports non-interactive server runs with policy overrides. Included: conciliator core, rule registry, v1->v2 migration adapter, brief-ranker, audit model, API route, CLI, tests, and docs. Backwards compatibility: legacy v1 profiles are preserved and migrated on-demand; conciliator appends audit entries rather than overwriting history. Rollout: behind feature flag conciliator.enabled; server-side auto-apply of safety tags is disabled by default and requires opt-in. Performance: reconciliation is CPU-bound with sub-250ms median for typical manifests in dev images. Follow-ups: canary gate for auto-apply, ML-suggested safety tag model, and a UI for manual review.
